"""Reviewer's own planted probes of W2-157's F4 judgement (W2-181). Read-only on the worktree; repos under argv[1]."""
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

TREE = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-181")
sys.path.insert(0, str(TREE / "tests/acceptance/W2-157"))
import test_w2_157_nothing_else as m  # noqa: E402

BASE = Path(sys.argv[1])
ENV = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null", "HOME": str(BASE)}
ID = ["-c", "user.name=P", "-c", "user.email=p@example.invalid", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false",
      "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null"]


def git(repo, *a):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *ID, *a], env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, (a, r.stderr)
    return r.stdout


def write(repo, path, text="x\n"):
    (repo / path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (repo / path).write_text(text)


def base_repo(name):
    repo = BASE / name
    repo.mkdir()
    git(repo, "init", "-q")
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/integrate")
    write(repo, ".tickets/DAEO-ozyt.md", m.TICKET.read_text())
    write(repo, "README.md", "base\n")
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", "base")
    return repo


def commit(repo, path, msg="c", text="x\n"):
    write(repo, path, text)
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", msg)


def outcome(repo):
    try:
        m.judge_f4_paths(repo)
        return "PASS"
    except pytest.skip.Exception as e:
        return f"SKIP: {e.msg}"
    except AssertionError as e:
        return f"FAIL: {str(e).splitlines()[0][:200]}"


cases = {}

# P1: own branch, a change outside its paths (another ticket's test folder)
r = base_repo("p1"); git(r, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-157"); commit(r, "src/gov/resources/backstop.py")
commit(r, "tests/acceptance/W2-158/test_x.py"); cases["P1 own branch, outside change (other ticket's tests)"] = outcome(r)

# P2: own branch edits its own ticket file (outside allowed_paths)
r = base_repo("p2"); git(r, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-157")
commit(r, ".tickets/DAEO-ozyt.md", text=m.TICKET.read_text() + "\nedited\n")
cases["P2 own branch edits its ticket file"] = outcome(r)

# P3: own branch with inside changes, integrate moves on with outside changes and is merged into the branch
r = base_repo("p3"); git(r, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-157"); commit(r, "src/gov/resources/backstop.py")
commit(r, "docs/probes/DAEO-ozyt/review.md"); commit(r, "tests/unit/resources/test_w2_157_a.py")
git(r, "checkout", "-q", "w2/integrate"); commit(r, "src/gov/other.py")
git(r, "checkout", "-q", "w2/W2-157"); git(r, "merge", "-q", "--no-ff", "-m", "merge integrate", "w2/integrate")
cases["P3 own branch, inside only, integrate merged in"] = outcome(r)

# P4: same as P3 plus one outside change after the merge
commit(r, "src/gov/resources/gate.py"); cases["P4 = P3 + outside change after the merge"] = outcome(r)

# P5: a similarly named branch (the tests branch) with an outside change
r = base_repo("p5"); git(r, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-157-tests"); commit(r, "src/gov/x.py")
cases["P5 branch w2/W2-157-tests with an outside change"] = outcome(r)

# P6: own branch with the ticket file absent on it (deleted)
r = base_repo("p6"); git(r, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-157"); git(r, "rm", "-q", ".tickets/DAEO-ozyt.md")
git(r, "commit", "-q", "-m", "rm"); commit(r, "src/gov/x.py")
cases["P6 own branch, ticket file deleted + outside change"] = outcome(r)

# P7: run from a cwd that is a different repo on w2/W2-157: branch read from root, not the cwd
r = base_repo("p7"); git(r, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-121c"); commit(r, "src/gov/resources/slots.py")
cases["P7 other ticket's branch (cwd is the worktree on w2/W2-181)"] = outcome(r)

for k, v in cases.items():
    print(f"{k}: {v}")

## Findings
